population.kidComparison: About 27.9 million people live in Niger—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Niger
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Niger.

exploration.didYouKnow: Niger is located in Western Africa and its capital city is Niamey.
